verdict.rationale: Close lists 'Automated workflows' as a product feature, and its docs mention managing workflows with sequences, so a first-party automation capability exists. The evidence does not show trigger conditions or the specific actions in the story. Webhooks and the event log are developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented trigger types, workflow actions that update records, workflow actions that create tasks, workflow-driven notifications, and in-depth workflow docs or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build trigger-based workflows that update records, create tasks, and send notifications automatically
